defects.scenarioId: A JTBD declaring numbered Rules and no ACs passes the intake-exit gate
defects.note: mutation operator: Then-to-non-claim. 'the gate finishes evaluating the JTBD' asserts only that the gate RAN, not its outcome (allow/deny) — a do-nothing gate that always finishes would satisfy it, and it no longer backs the scenario's 'passes the gate' claim. Adversarially adjacent to the clean allow/deny outcomes in the sibling scenarios. Other two scenarios unchanged & clean.
